title: EGIS: Entropy Guided Image Synthesis for Dataset-Agnostic Testing of RRAM-Based DNNs
problem: RRAM-based DNNs are vulnerable to manufacturing process variations; post-manufacture testing requires dataset access which may be unavailable due to privacy constraints.
motivation: RRAM crossbars show promise for edge inference but suffer manufacturing variability; dataset-agnostic testing enables quality control without compromising training data privacy.
method: Entropy Guided Image Synthesis (EGIS) generates synthetic test images minimizing entropy-based loss metric; extracts compact image subset (10-20 images) for rapid testing; uses ML-based outlier detector for pass/fail classification.
key_novelty: Entropy-driven synthetic image generation for dataset-agnostic manufacturing variation testing without access to original training data.
contributions: Compact test image subset (10-20 images) for rapid testing
ML-based outlier detection for RRAM crossbar quality assessment
Test accuracy comparable to contemporary methods
limitations: Specific accuracy comparison numbers not provided in abstract.
